INSERT INTO social_saved_spots ( id, user_id, social_job_id, candidate_ref, content_type, name, query, description, useful_info, visit_guidance, address_hint, latitude, longitude, google_place_id, place_id, day_hint, sequence, time_hint, option_group_id, option_index, relation, identity_status, resolution_status, evidence, image_url, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{spot.id}, #{spot.userId}, #{spot.socialJobId}, #{spot.candidateRef}, #{spot.contentType}, #{spot.name}, #{spot.query}, #{spot.description}, CAST(#{spot.usefulInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), CAST(#{spot.visitGuidance,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{spot.addressHint}, #{spot.latitude}, #{spot.longitude}, #{spot.googlePlaceId}, #{spot.placeId}, #{spot.dayHint}, #{spot.sequence}, #{spot.timeHint}, #{spot.optionGroupId}, #{spot.optionIndex}, #{spot.relation}, #{spot.identityStatus}, #{spot.resolutionStatus}, CAST(#{spot.evidence,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{spot.imageUrl}, COALESCE(#{spot.createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{spot.updatedAt}, NOW()))
ON CONFLICT (user_id, social_job_id, candidate_ref) DO UPDATE SET content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, name = EXCLUDED.name, query = EXCLUDED.query, description = EXCLUDED.description, useful_info = EXCLUDED.useful_info, visit_guidance = EXCLUDED.visit_guidance, address_hint = EXCLUDED.address_hint, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, google_place_id = EXCLUDED.google_place_id, place_id = EXCLUDED.place_id, day_hint = EXCLUDED.day_hint, sequence = EXCLUDED.sequence, time_hint = EXCLUDED.time_hint, option_group_id = EXCLUDED.option_group_id, option_index = EXCLUDED.option_index, relation = EXCLUDED.relation, identity_status = EXCLUDED.identity_status, resolution_status = EXCLUDED.resolution_status, evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM social_saved_spots WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
